territory: 主要活动于豫西、晋南的中原腹地，中心在颍水、伊洛流域；四至难确考，约西起豫西、东至鲁西、北抵冀南、南达江淮。
territoryEn: Centered on the Central Plains (western Henan, southern Shanxi) around the Ying and Luo river basins; exact bounds uncertain — roughly from western Henan east to western Shandong, north to southern Hebei, south to the Jiang–Huai region.

territory: 以河南北部、河北南部为中心，后期迁殷（今安阳）；势力范围西起陕西、东至海滨、北抵燕山、南达江汉。
territoryEn: Centered in northern Henan and southern Hebei, later moving to Yin (Anyang); influence stretched west to Shaanxi, east to the coast, north to the Yan Mountains, south to the Jianghan plain.

territory: 西周起于关中，都镐京，分封诸侯，势力西起甘陕、东至海滨、北逾燕赵、南及江汉；东周王室衰微，实际控制限于洛邑一带。
territoryEn: The Western Zhou rose in the Guanzhong basin (Haojing), with fiefs across the realm — west to Gansu/Shaanxi, east to the coast, north beyond Yan–Zhao, south to the Jianghan; the Eastern Zhou court shrank to the Luoyi area.

territory: 结束分裂，首次大一统：东临大海、西抵陇西、北筑长城拒匈奴、南取岭南设郡。
territoryEn: First unified empire: east to the sea, west to Longxi, north with the Great Wall against the Xiongnu, south annexing Lingnan into commanderies.

territory: 极盛时东临大海、西逾葱岭、北抵阴山、南达南海；西域都护府统辖今新疆，势力至朝鲜半岛北部与越南北部。
territoryEn: At its height: east to the sea, west beyond the Pamirs, north to the Yin Mountains, south to the South China Sea; the Western Regions Protectorate governed today's Xinjiang, with influence into northern Korea and northern Vietnam.
area: 约 609 万 km²（西汉极盛）

territory: 魏据中原（黄河流域）、蜀控巴蜀（益州）、吴领江东与江南；三国鼎立，疆界以秦岭—淮河为要。
territoryEn: Wei held the Central Plains (Yellow River basin), Shu controlled Bashu (Yi province), Wu ruled Jiangdong and the south; the realms were split along the Qinling–Huai line.
area: 约 400 万 km²（三国合计，存疑）

territory: 西晋短期统一，疆域约承汉旧境；东晋偏安江南，北面为十六国割据，实际控制限江淮以南。
territoryEn: The Western Jin briefly reunified roughly the Han realm; the Eastern Jin retreated south of the Yangtze, with the north fragmented among the Sixteen Kingdoms.

territory: 南朝（宋齐梁陈）守江南，北朝（北魏等）据中原与塞北；疆界动荡，淮河—秦岭为界。
territoryEn: The Southern Dynasties (Liu Song, Southern Qi, Liang, Chen) held the south; Northern Dynasties (Northern Wei, etc.) controlled the Central Plains and steppe; the Huai–Qinling line divided them.
area: 约 400 万 km²（南北合计，存疑）

territory: 重归一统，疆域近汉极盛：东至海、西抵青海、北御突厥、南括岭南。
territoryEn: Reunified the realm near Han's maximal extent: east to the sea, west to Qinghai, north against the Türks, south including Lingnan.

territory: 极盛时东临大海、西达咸海、北包贝加尔、南至越南；羁縻府州辽阔，为历代版图巅峰之一。
territoryEn: At its height: east to the sea, west to the Aral region, north to Lake Baikal, south to Vietnam; vast tributary commanderies marked one of history's largest Chinese realms.

territory: 中原五代递嬗，周边十国分立；疆域碎片化，中原核心在黄河中下游，南方诸国各据一方。
territoryEn: The Five Dynasties succeeded in the Central Plains while the Ten Kingdoms split the periphery; the realm fragmented, with the core along the middle–lower Yellow River and southern states holding their own.
area: 约 300 万 km²（五代中原，存疑）

territory: 北宋统一中原与江南，北以幽云—秦岭为界（失燕云）；南宋退守淮河—大散关以南，偏安江南。
territoryEn: The Northern Song unified the Central Plains and Jiangnan, bordered north by the Yan–Yun line (lost the Sixteen Prefectures); the Southern Song withdrew south of the Huai and Dasan Pass.
area: 约 280 万 km²（北宋峰值）

territory: 契丹所建，据燕云以北的北方草原与东北：西起阿尔泰山、东临海、北至外兴安岭、南抵幽燕。
territoryEn: Founded by the Khitan across the northern steppe and northeast: west to the Altai, east to the sea, north to the Outer Khingan, south to the Yan–Yun region.

territory: 党项所建，据河西走廊与宁夏、陕北、陇右：东界黄河、西至玉门、南抵祁连、北达大漠。
territoryEn: Founded by the Tangut over the Hexi Corridor, Ningxia, northern Shaanxi and Longyou: east to the Yellow River, west to Yumen, south to the Qilian, north to the desert.

territory: 女真所建，灭辽与北宋，据淮河以北的中国北方：东临海、西邻西夏、北至外兴安岭、南抵秦岭—淮河。
territoryEn: Founded by the Jurchen after conquering Liao and the Northern Song, holding north China south of the Huai: east to the sea, west bordering Xixia, north to the Outer Khingan, south to the Qinling–Huai line.

territory: 蒙古帝国继承者，疆域空前：东至海、西抵中亚、北含西伯利亚、南达南海与吐蕃、大理。
territoryEn: Heir to the Mongol Empire with an unprecedented extent: east to the sea, west into Central Asia, north across Siberia, south to the South China Sea, Tibet and Dali.

territory: 汉族重建大一统：初期都南京，后迁北京；疆域东至海、西抵西域、北修长城、南抚安南（后弃），东北设奴儿干都司。
territoryEn: A Han-led reunification: first capital Nanjing, later moved to Beijing; east to the sea, west toward the Western Regions, the Great Wall in the north, with the Nurgan commandery in the northeast.

territory: 疆域奠近代中国版图：东至海、西达帕米尔、北逾外兴安岭、南括南海；收台湾、定漠北、辖西藏与新疆，幅员为历代之最。
territoryEn: Set the modern Chinese map: east to the sea, west to the Pamirs, north beyond the Outer Khingan, south to the South China Sea; with Taiwan, Mongolia, Tibet and Xinjiang integrated — the largest realm of all dynasties.
